data.title: Risk-high static review: exact current child builder fbf32fd0
data.description: Independent STATIC-ONLY review of exact bn-30fs commit fbf32fd0696d43c917bb6f633c35358690a8c232 (tree d486a89354e3d66667f9a466a2d9ce5bb8a9a840) against main 192c1ebd. Scope is the exact six-file builder delta. Validate selective cfg(test)+private wrapper targeting only mess_store lib; conceptual correctness/fault example compilation; pristine/hooked twins before children; exact compile-out env; semantic overlay/fault/static/lock authorities; placeholder sentinels/final tools; per-build live admission; descriptor-bound source/wrapper/target/receipt and stable artifact copy; full-tree identities; truthful preapproval sentinel; no normal release hook leakage; correctness/fault smoke compatibility. Attack TOCTOU, merged lock_authority/fault API mismatch, attestation cycles, hidden build risk, and regressions. Permitted only static Python validators/self-tests, AST, rustfmt parse/check, diff/Seal inspection. No Cargo/rustc/build/product/child/network/measurement execution and no source edits.

data.body: [HIGH] The receipt is parsed but not authenticated as the exact cfg-injection event. This read only enforces regular-file/nlink stability;  accepts any non-executable mode,  checks only schema/canonical JSON, and the sole later semantic check is  at line 2227. Because the receipt directory remains a writable bind,  can be unlinked/replaced after the exact wrapper publishes it with another canonical object carrying the same schema and nonce. The resulting attestation can therefore claim injection without requiring the exact key set or the expected , , , , injected argument vector, pinned rustc, and 64-character lower-hex original argv hash. It also does not require the wrapper's promised exact 0444 receipt mode (nlink=1 is checked). Fail closed on the complete receipt object and exact identity, and extend the static hostile suite to reject removal/change of every consumer check plus removal of  in the wrapper.

[Correction with identifiers preserved] [HIGH] The receipt is parsed but not authenticated as the exact cfg-injection event. This read only enforces regular-file and nlink stability; snapshot_open_file accepts any non-executable mode, parse_canonical checks only schema and canonical JSON, and the sole later semantic check is wrapper_receipt.build_nonce == build_nonce at line 2227. Because the receipt directory remains a writable bind, injection.json can be unlinked and replaced after the exact wrapper publishes it with another canonical object carrying the same schema and nonce. The resulting attestation can claim injection without requiring the exact key set or the expected crate_name=mess_store, package=mess-store, source=crates/mess-store/src/lib.rs, crate_type=lib, injected argument vector, pinned rustc, and 64-character lower-hex original argv hash. It also does not require the wrapper promised exact 0444 receipt mode; nlink=1 is checked. Fail closed on the complete receipt object and exact identity, and extend the static hostile suite to reject removal or change of every consumer check plus removal of os.fchmod(descriptor, 0o444) in the wrapper.

[HIGH] The per-build resample covers only free-space and filesystem policy; it does not replay the Cargo config-search authority that validate_authority checked earlier. validate_authority calls production_context and prepare_overlays.validate_lock_manifest before materialization, which replays the recorded cwd ancestor, root, and CARGO_HOME config candidates. Each later Cargo invocation sees a live read-only host root plus the live pinned CARGO_HOME through bubblewrap. A same-user change to CARGO_HOME/config.toml or /.cargo/config.toml after initial validation but before or during any of the three builds can alter rustflags, target, linker, source replacement, or other Cargo behavior, then be restored before the end checks. The final validated_authority_records and toolchain_identities checks only cached authority snapshots and executable files, not a fresh semantic validation or those config paths. Replay or descriptor-bind the exact Cargo config authority immediately before each build and verify it after each build, and add hostile coverage demonstrating that cached-only rechecks are rejected.

data.reason: Two high-severity fail-closed authority gaps: the builder accepts a schema-plus-nonce receipt without exact semantic and 0444 validation, and Cargo configuration authority is only replayed at initial lock validation rather than at each live build boundary.
